The Snap Circuits® kit uses building blocks with snaps to build the different electrical and electronic circuits in the projects. Measure the Vibration as You Tap the Switch Project #686 Build the circuit and turn on the slide switch (S1). Vibration Alarm Turn on the slide switch (S1) and shake the circuit or bang on the table; an alarm will sound.
